# axm commands update

Update installed commands to latest versions

## When to use

Update installed commands to latest versions

## Usage

```bash
axm commands update [flags] [<name>]
```

## Arguments

| Name   | Type   | Required | Description                                            |
| ------ | ------ | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| `name` | string | No       | Name of the command to update (updates all if omitted) |

## Flags

| Name            | Type    | Required | Description                                                                               |
| --------------- | ------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--scope`       | choice  | No       | Update commands in project (default) or user-level configuration (choices: project, user) |
| `--yes`, `-y`   | boolean | No       | Apply all updates without confirmation                                                    |
| `--force`, `-f` | boolean | No       | Update even if version constraints would prevent it                                       |
| `--preview`     | boolean | No       | Show available updates without applying them                                              |

Global flags are documented on [Global flags](../global-flags).

## Examples

**Update all commands to their latest versions**

```bash
axm commands update
```

**Update a specific command**

```bash
axm commands update my-cmd
```

**Preview available updates**

```bash
axm commands update --preview
```

## Requirements

None.

## Side effects

None.
